title: Iki environment binding (iki/v1)
description: The compute templates a plugin's environment runs on in this deployment. For each job, Iki picks the template with the lowest priority number it fits, then the smallest of those.

environment.description: The plugin and its environment, such as `structure_prediction.alphafold-gpu`.

priority.description: Lower numbers are tried first, such as spot (0) before on-demand (1). Defaults to 0.
